Hi — I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (this machine is mine to work on). Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **Your own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Do you want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — I can sign myself up (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Beyond that** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've also got your setup: I'm Sarah's TA agent for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and I keep the week in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md. What would you like to start with?

2. I have a name but no gender set for myself; tell me which form you'd like me to use (neuter is my default).

What would you like to start with — shall I check the schedule against requests from the TAs?

One thing is missing: my name and gender aren't set. Shall I stay mara-agent and use neuter forms, or would you like something else?

Before I book it — your next week is packed. A one-hour meeting doesn't fit any day inside 09:00–17:00. The only gaps for the professor's calendar are 30 minutes:

- Mon 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30

Also: who attends — all five TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego) or a subset? Once you tell me the day, length and attendees, I'll ask them for availability, book the slot that works for everyone, and log it.
